scope: Implement the ready local subset of PAR-100/7BG for DXF UCS orthographic option tuples, using the corrected tuple and scalar-field boundary from the accompanying research receipt.

changes.details: Pending code-71 option finalization requires selector 1-6 and a complete unique 13/23/33 coordinate mask. DXF UCS serialization writes group 79 as zero and refuses unresolved nonzero shared orthoType or base-UCS handle state; repeated option tuples remain ordered and no standalone code-13 point is emitted.
DXF validation accepts only documented group-71 selector values 1-6, separate from shared DWG payload validation.
Clarified that shared orthoType/DXF group 79 is not the repeated DXF group-71 option selector.

Added --ucs-orthographic-options focused selector and default-suite coverage. Generated ASCII/binary tests exercise option round trips, zero points, group-79 ordering, copy/reset, malformed coordinate tuples, selector range, non-finite values, unresolved group-79/base state, legacy ambiguity, target-version refusal, and option-cap refusal.

focusedSelector.note: Expected parser diagnostics appeared for generated negative records.

worktree.reason: The shared worktree contains a large mixed set of unrelated and user-owned modifications; this implementation slice was kept isolated from a commit.
